captions.formal: Vehicles travel along a multi-lane city road lined with yellow-leafed trees and apartment buildings, with some cars appearing as motion-blurred streaks in the bright daylight.
captions.sarcastic: A thrilling display of high-speed travel, provided your definition of speed involves blurring into a streak while sitting in city traffic.
captions.humorous_tech: City traffic experiencing some serious latency, with several vehicles attempting to optimize their packet delivery via motion blur.
captions.humorous_non_tech: A whole city of drivers racing toward their destinations, some moving so fast they have decided to stop being solid objects entirely.

captions.formal: An orange kitten walks forward on a dirt path through a wooded setting, lifting its front paws while approaching the camera under dappled light.
captions.sarcastic: A truly terrifying predator, dominating the entire frame one tiny, high-stepping paw at a time.
captions.humorous_tech: An orange kitten deploys toward the camera on a dirt path, slowly filling the frame as it pushes its high-stepping update to production.
captions.humorous_non_tech: This orange kitten marches through the woods with the sheer confidence of a tiny landlord coming to collect the rent.

captions.formal: A woman in a light-colored blazer and orange top sits at a white desk in an office, typing on a keyboard while facing a computer monitor.
captions.sarcastic: An absolute masterclass in high-stakes drama: a woman sitting at a desk and typing on a keyboard.
captions.humorous_tech: The woman types away with the focused intensity of someone trying to resolve a merge conflict before the weekend begins.
captions.humorous_non_tech: She stares at that monitor with the intense focus of a woman writing a letter she knows will start a very long family argument.

captions.formal: A waterfall descends a dark, rocky cliffside through lush green vegetation, creating a mist that drifts across the scene.
captions.sarcastic: A breathtaking display of ambition: this water has spent the entire clip tirelessly committing to the single task of falling down.
captions.humorous_tech: This waterfall is deploying a continuous stream of data to the rocks below with zero latency and absolutely no merge conflicts.
captions.humorous_non_tech: This water is coming down the cliff with the absolute determination of someone who just remembered they left the oven on.

captions.formal: A camera pans across a city skyline at night, zooming in on a curved building with horizontal white lighting and a tiered roofline.
captions.sarcastic: A breathtaking cinematic journey across an entire skyline, all for the privilege of staring at one curved building with some white lights.
captions.humorous_tech: The camera zooms in on that curved building with the precision of a developer hunting for the one line of code causing the production incident.
captions.humorous_non_tech: The camera glides toward that curved building like a nosy neighbor who just spotted something scandalous happening behind the white lights.

captions.formal: White and grey birds gather on a sandy shoreline near blue water as others fly overhead and dark-colored birds move across the sand against a backdrop of distant mountains.
captions.sarcastic: A truly bustling metropolis, provided your definition of urban planning involves several birds standing on some sand.
captions.humorous_tech: A group of birds syncing to the shoreline server as new instances deploy from the sky and dark-colored bugs crawl across the sand.
captions.humorous_non_tech: A massive boardroom meeting on the sand where the newcomers are landing late and the dark-colored birds are clearly the management.

captions.formal: Pedestrians cross a busy city intersection from all directions as vehicles stop. A white delivery truck drives through the urban center as the crowds disperse.
captions.sarcastic: A masterclass in urban efficiency: several hundred people crossing in every direction just to make a single white delivery truck feel welcome.
captions.humorous_tech: The intersection experiences a massive data packet collision as pedestrians deploy from all corners, finally resolving the merge conflict when a white truck clears the lane.
captions.humorous_non_tech: Hundreds of pedestrians launch a coordinated invasion of the crosswalk, only to surrender the street the moment a single white delivery truck decides it is time to move.

captions.formal: A person in a maroon shirt and neon yellow shoes kicks a soccer ball on a green turf field at dusk as a second person in a blue shirt runs alongside.
captions.sarcastic: A breathtaking display of athletic prowess: two people running across a field at dusk, managed by a camera that is far more excited than the players.
captions.humorous_tech: The player in neon yellow shoes deploys the soccer ball into production, while the camera zooms out to monitor the latency of the chase.
captions.humorous_non_tech: One person in neon yellow shoes sends the ball flying while a friend in blue chases after it like it owes them money.

captions.formal: Chopped red onions, red peppers, and mushrooms sauté in a black frying pan over orange flames against a dark, smoky background.
captions.sarcastic: A truly daring display of athletics from these vegetables, leaping into the air just to land right back in the pan.
captions.humorous_tech: The vegetables are being repeatedly tossed in the pan like a series of rapid deployments to a very hot production environment.
captions.humorous_non_tech: These vegetables are leaping for their lives in a pan that has clearly decided they need an urgent lesson in fire dancing.

captions.formal: A camera tilts upward through rain-soaked branches and green leaves toward a canopy as sunlight creates a lens flare and white glowing orbs.
captions.sarcastic: A truly riveting cinematic journey: we start with some wet leaves and end with a lens flare that effectively erases the entire scenery.
captions.humorous_tech: The camera tilts up through the rain, only for a massive lens flare to crash the system and trigger a total screen whiteout in production.
captions.humorous_non_tech: The tree starts with a moody rain shower, only to be completely blinded by the sun like it just walked into a bright room without its glasses.

captions.formal: A person wearing black-rimmed glasses stares forward against a dark background as blue digital code and data streams scroll vertically across the frame and reflect in the lenses.
captions.sarcastic: Truly a cutting-edge display of processing power: staring blankly while blue blur scrolls across the glasses.
captions.humorous_tech: That look of absolute stillness when you are debugging a production incident and the logs are scrolling faster than you can read them.
captions.humorous_non_tech: He stares ahead with the intensity of someone trying to remember if he actually turned the stove off before leaving the house.
